author: Excessionismine
quote:
AWESOME what a great game, visually stunning, audio is atmospheric and with a bonkers and OTT alternate history this game is a AAA gem.

Running on an intel i5 (boosted) to 3.2mhz, 8 gig 1600mhz ram, 2gig HD7890, Win 7 64bit OS installed on a Corsair SSD the game runs smoothly on High settings with shadows reduced from 4098 to 2046.

I appreciate there are many software and hardware combo's and that some may issues with new titles but outside of Battlefield 4 (Publisher FAIL) this setup has run all the latest titles on full settings without issue.

10/10 to the developers, artists, writers and coders that have created this stunning work. Thank you your passion and hard work is apparent in every frame.

For all the low scoring overly critical buggy system haters show some love, can you code, paint, write. When did you last create something? Is it in you to birth an original idea,thought, meme. Come on Gamers show the LOVE
